thread:
Harper (Product): Shortcut sync: customers want three things in the console next quarter: clear per-route cost, lightweight trace hooks for debugging, and error analytics that show representative inputs. Need a concise MVP, acceptance gates, and a safe beta plan.

Liam (Eng-runtime): High-level feasible. Plan: emit minimal event envelopes from runtime (no blocking), add a sampling SDK and server-side sampling rules. We should expose an SDK call to force-capture a trace for debugging.

Chen (Eng-SRE): Ops constraints: default sampling 0.5%, per-org daily cap, and an emergency capture mode (on for 1 hour) limited by quota. Retention presets: 7/30/90. Must add alerts if span ingestion >2x baseline.

Aya (Design): UI ideas: a compact Cost by Route card with percent and sparkline, a Sampled Traces list with quick-open flamegraph, and an Error Insights panel (top groups, trend, one sample per group with redaction). I'll produce lightweight mocks for small and large orgs.

Rafael (Data): Schema draft: tags = [org_id, route_id, model_hash, variant, plan_tier]; fields = [tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, success_flag]. Cost = token_count * model_unit_cost + infra_markup. For the beta we'll backfill 14 days on opt-in only.

Harper (Product): Proposed launch gates: 1) per-route cost within 5-7% vs invoice for beta orgs, 2) trace capture must not increase p99 inference latency by >12%, 3) error insights surface top-5 groups with at least one sample for 80% of groups. Beta: 3 customers + internal teams for 3 weeks.

Liam (Eng-runtime): Implementation notes: nonblocking pre/post hooks, async uploader to a dedicated trace queue, server-side sampling rules supporting route, latency, and explicit SDK triggers. Example rule: {default:0.005, overrides:[{route:"chat-stream",rate:0.02},{latency_gt_ms:600,rate:1.0}] }.

Chen (Eng-SRE): Rollback criteria: sustained p99 regression >15% after 30m, trace ingestion exceeding autoscale budget for >1h, or cost reporting variance >10% causing billing confusion. We'll require a load test at 5x expected beta volume.

Aya (Design): UX acceptance checklist: drilldown from cost row -> traces/errors; trace open in existing viewer; sample input hidden by default with reveal opt-in; mobile layout present.

Rafael (Data): Backfill note: backfill job will be queued and rate-limited; estimate ~1 CPU-hour per 50M requests. Need a backfill approval flow in the console to avoid accidental-wide jobs.

Harper (Product): Action items: Liam -> short RFC with perf targets + SDK example by tomorrow; Chen -> sizing + load-test plan; Rafael -> metric schema + backfill runbook; Aya -> mocks. I'll create beta invites and a one-page launch criteria doc.

Liam (Eng-runtime): Will post RFC with code snippets and perf regression harness.

Chen (Eng-SRE): I'll create infra sizing tickets and alert rules. Need span/day estimates for beta orgs.

ops-bot: Ticket OBS-6910 created: "Console: per-route cost + sampled traces + error insights" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-6910

Harper (Product): Thanks team. If no objections, I'll lock scope and start outreach to beta customers.

Liam (Eng-runtime): SGTM.

Aya (Design): SGTM.

Rafael (Data): SGTM.

Chen (Eng-SRE): SGTM.
